versions.changelog:
- Initial release of real-time crypto market intelligence via Messari's REST API.

- Supports AI-powered analysis, on-chain metrics, sentiment, news, research, stablecoins, exchanges, protocols, token unlocks, fundraising, governance events, key developments and more.

- Requires user-provided Messari API key (and Messari AI credits for chat completion).

- Includes detailed service routing table and example API requests for all endpoints.

- Guides users on how to route different types of crypto questions to appropriate services.
